name: B10-0423/2026 – § 27 – Am 12
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the upcoming EU anti-corruption strategy
part_text: 27. Considers it essential that the EU gain full member status in the Council of Europe cooperation framework GRECO, building on its current observer status; highlights the existing accountability gap between the Member States, which are all evaluated by GRECO, and the EU, which is not; emphasises that EU institutions have to be subject to the same level of scrutiny and standards as national authorities; calls on the Member States to fully implement GRECO’s recommendations on anti-corruption, as well as their own national anti-corruption strategies, recalling that some Member States have so far failed to comply with these recommendations; asks in this regard that common minimum transparency and integrity standards be introduced and applied to all EU institutions; recalls that the Rules of Procedure still need to be amended to ensure the effective implementation of the Interinstitutional Body for Ethical Standards within Parliament;
